Purpose.Value: so the CLI can answer questions about the stored topology without each command walking units and relations itself

Responsibility.Value: Answers read-only queries over stored units: one unit at a glance, the strongest shortest path between two units, what a change to some units reaches, and how the topology differs between two revisions.

Units.Name: diff report fields
Units.Sentence: Fixes the JSON field names of the diff (units_added, units_removed, contract_signatures_changed, contract_code_changed, relations_added, relations_removed, inferred_added) that abbd diff --json prints.

Units.Name: top-level unit rule
Units.Sentence: a unit is top level when it has no parent; the screen also lifts a unit whose parent is absent, while diff, understand and explain test the Parent field alone

Units.Name: origin strength order
Units.Sentence: EXTRACTED beats USER_STATED beats INFERRED; topology ranks paths by it, the screen picks a wire's origin with its own copy, identity keeps the extracted copy of a repeated edge

Units.Name: contract code digest
Units.Sentence: the extraction script's digest of a contract's code; identity carries it, bootstrap clears it for a reader's unit, and diff reads an empty digest as unknown and a changed one as code changed under the same signature

Units.Name: contract provider rule
Units.Sentence: which module provides a contract; topology counts only a provides relation, while the screen also counts the module a contract sits inside

Units.Name: boundary rule
Units.Sentence: Decides that a diff reaches the boundary when a contract's signature changed, a contract was added or removed, or a drawn relation between top-level units appeared or went; a contract's code change under the same signature does not count.

Units.Name: topology diff
Units.Sentence: Compares two unit sets into sorted categories: units added and removed, contract signatures changed, contract code changed under the same signature, drawn relations between top-level units (an inside unit's relation lifted to its module), and reader couplings added.

Units.Name: impact walk
Units.Sentence: Walks from the seeds (and units inside seed modules) to dependents, consumers, contract providers and provided contracts, marks what the seeds use without following it, and splits the result into a direct and a far tier.

Units.Name: live links
Units.Sentence: Lists every relation between present units that is not dead, extracted, stated or inferred, with its origin, via and evidence, and labels each with where it comes from.

Units.Name: unit explanation
Units.Sentence: Gathers one present unit, the units inside it, its drawn links out and in (counting an inside unit's link across the boundary as the unit's own), and the reader couplings touching it or anything inside it.

Units.Name: strongest shortest path
Units.Sentence: Finds the shortest undirected walk over live links and, among equally short walks, the one whose weakest hop is strongest by the order extracted over stated over inferred, and reports that weakest origin.

Steps.Fails: stops when project.yaml names no script; run abbd setup first

Steps.Does: runScript(argv) → the script's stdout, run in the project root

Quotes: internal/extract/extract.go "func Parse(r io.Reader) (Result, error) { return parse(r, false) }"

Steps.Fails: Writable refuses a state with a unit file in the old format; run abbd migrate

Steps.Does: Snapshot(root, .abbd) → the working tree's fingerprint
Steps.Note: .abbd/ is left out, so committing the state leaves the tree unchanged

Steps.Does: Renames(last fingerprint, tree) → files moved since the last sync
Steps.Fails: warns and finds no moves when the last snapshot is gone

Steps.Does: Head() → the revision, taken only when the tree changed
Steps.Note: a sync of an unchanged tree keeps the stored revision

Steps.Fails: refuses an extraction with no units while units are stored
